how_to_apply: Visit the official TISS website at www.tiss.ac.in.
Carefully read the advertisement and ensure eligibility criteria are met for the desired post.
Submit separate online applications for each post applied for through the online application link.
Fill in all required information and upload scanned copies of certificates, marksheets, photograph, signature, and valid category/PwBD certificates as per size limits.
Pay the required application fee online based on your category.
Submit the online application before the last date of 09-11-2026.
Keep a printout of the filled application form and email acknowledgement for future reference.
important_instructions: Only online applications will be accepted; applications submitted through any other mode will be rejected. Candidates must submit separate applications for each post if applying for more than one position. SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD candidates applying against unreserved vacancies are not eligible for age relaxation or other category-specific relaxations. Applicants applying for posts reserved for OBC and EWS must upload a valid certificate issued for the current financial year by the Competent Authority. Candidates already in service with Central Govt, State Govt, Centrally funded Autonomous Bodies, Universities, or Public Sector Undertakings must submit a Vigilance Clearance Certificate and No Objection Certificate at the time of written test/interview. No TA/DA shall be paid to candidates for attending the interview. Canvassing in any form or bringing political or other influence will result in disqualification. Jurisdiction for any legal proceedings or disputes shall be restricted to the High Court, Mumbai.

content_sections.heading: TISS Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There are a total of 16 vacancies available across various non-teaching positions. The posts advertised are tentative. * Deputy Registrar 1 (UR) post is on Deputation, initially for one year. The candidate may be considered for absorption subject to administrative requirements and availability of post.

content_sections.heading: TISS Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a citizen of India.

rows.qualification_required: Master’s Degree with at least 55% marks or equivalent grade 'B' in UGC seven-point scale, plus nine years of experience as Assistant Professor in Academic Level 10 and above with experience in educational administration; OR comparable experience in research establishment/higher education institutions; OR 5 years of administrative experience as Assistant Registrar in Pay Level 10 or equivalent. (For Deputation: Officers holding analogous posts on regular basis or with five years regular service in pay level 11). One Deputy Registrar position requires specialization in Finance/Accounts, Audit and related fields.

Master's Degree in Library Science/Information Science/Documentation Science with at least 55% marks or equivalent grade, eight years experience as Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian, evidence of innovative library services including ICT integration, and a Ph.D. Degree in Library Science/Information Science/Documentation Science/Archives and Manuscript Keeping/Computerization of Library.

Master’s Degree in Library Science/Information Science/Documentation or equivalent professional degree with at least 55% marks, consistently good academic record with knowledge of library computerization, and must have cleared NET/SLET/SET or awarded Ph.D. in accordance with relevant regulations.
Master’s Degree with at least 55% of marks or its equivalent grade of ‘B’ in the UGC seven-point scale.

Master’s Degree in Social Sciences with at least 55% marks or equivalent grade ‘B’ in UGC seven-point scale with ten years' experience, minimum seven years' experience in publishing or public relations industry, proficiency in computerized administrative systems, good writing and social media skills, and well-versed with DTP programs like Coral Ventura, Coral Draw, Adobe Indesign, QuarkXpress, and online platforms.

First class in M.E./M.Tech. (Computer Science & Technology/Information Technology) with two years of relevant experience; OR First class in Master in Computer Applications (MCA) with two years of relevant experience; OR First class M.Sc. (Computer Science/Information Technology) from recognized University/Institute with three years of relevant experience.
MBBS recognized by Medical Council of India, registered with MCI/State Medical Council, and three years of working experience in a hospital attached with a medical college/corporate hospital.
Master’s Degree in Social Work with at least 55% of marks or its equivalent grade of ‘B’ in UGC seven-point scale, and 15 years' experience in field work.

Masters in Social Work / Counselling / Applied Psychology with ten years of experience in counselling adolescent students, strong leadership, administrative, written and oral communication skills, and ability to plan and conduct training programs.

A Bachelor’s Degree in any stream from any recognised Institute/University, and three years of experience in supervisory level in Pay Level 6 in areas related to Administration/Establishment/Finance/Academic matters in a University or other Institutions of Higher Education/Research Establishment/PSU/Government organizations.

A Bachelor’s Degree in any stream from any recognised Institute/University with five years experience as Security Supervisor/Supervisory position in Security in a Govt. office, Educational Institution, Private organisation of repute with annual turnover of Rs. 200/- crores and above; OR Person who has served in the Army or such Uniformed service at JCO level or equivalent or above with 10th standard pass or Army class I Examination or an equivalent examination AND holding a valid driving license (LMV/Motor Cycle).

rows.category: SC / ST / OBC (Central List) / PwBD / Ex-servicemen
rows.relaxation: Upper age limit relaxable as per Govt of India orders issued from time to time.

Upper age limit relaxable up to a maximum of five years or the number of years of service whichever is less, provided they have rendered at least three years regular service in Central Govt, State Govt, Central Universities, UGC maintained deemed to be universities, or other Central/State autonomous bodies/organisations/institutions.
Upper age limit relaxed up to pay level 9, provided they have acquired requisite qualification and experience.

rows.details: Tata Institute of Social Sciences Portal

faq.question: Q1. What is TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: TISS Recruitment 2026 is an official notification released by the Tata Institute of Social Sciences to hire eligible candidates for 16 Non-Teaching positions across Mumbai, Tuljapur, Guwahati, and Hyderabad campuses.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in TISS Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 16 vacancies available for various posts including Deputy Registrar, Deputy Librarian, Assistant Librarian, Assistant Registrar, Assistant Manager, System Analyst, Health Officer, Field Work Coordinator, Counsellor, and Section Officer.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date of receipt of applications online is 09-11-2026, subject to extension as per the advertisement published in Employment News.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for UR candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for UR candidates is Rs. 2,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for Women, OBC, and EWS candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for OBC, EWS, and Women candidates is Rs. 1,500/-.

faq.question: Q6. Are offline applications accepted for TISS Non-Teaching posts?
faq.answer: No, only online applications will be accepted.

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply for multiple posts using a single application?
faq.answer: No, candidates must submit separate applications for each post applied for.

faq.question: Q8. What is the qualification required for Section Officer?
faq.answer: A Bachelor’s Degree in any stream from any recognised Institute/University with three years of experience in supervisory level in Pay Level 6 in administrative, establishment, finance, or academic matters in a university, higher education institution, research establishment, PSU, or government organization.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, the upper age limit is relaxable for SC, ST, OBC, PwBD, Ex-servicemen, and regular service employees in accordance with Government of India orders.

faq.question: Q10. Who should I contact for technical support regarding the online application?
faq.answer: For technical support, candidates can contact [email protected] or the helpline number 022-25525252.
